# Aperture LUTs and effects: LUT, invert, posterize, threshold, gamma

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/effects-lut`

## Summary

A 3D LUT (.cube up to size 65) with an intensity mix, and the effect layers invert, posterize, threshold and gamma.

## Details

### Layer type `lut` (LUT; panel LUT)
- `cube`: text
- `intensity` (Intensity): 0 to 1, default 1
### Layer type `invert` (Invert; panel Effects)
- no parameters
### Layer type `posterize` (Posterize; panel Effects)
- `levels`: integer 2 to 255, default 4
### Layer type `threshold` (Threshold; panel Effects)
- `level`: 0 to 1, default 0.5
### Layer type `gamma` (Gamma; panel Effects)
- `gamma`: 0.1 to 10, default 1
Every adjustment layer also has opacity 0–1, blend normal/luminosity/color, enabled, an optional name and an optional mask. Percent-style values (-100 to 100) are 0 when unchanged.
